applicant.name: Dr. Verena Huber
applicant.organisation: Austrian Society for Diabetes Quality Assurance

purpose: Benchmarking of glycaemic control between hospitals as part of a national quality improvement initiative.
question: Among adults with type 2 diabetes, what proportion at each hospital has poorly controlled blood sugar?
definitions: Adult = 18 years or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = a condition with ICD-10 code E11 (any subcode).
Take each patient's most recent HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4); patients with no HbA1c are not counted.
Report per data holder: adults with type 2 diabetes and an HbA1c value, how many of them are poorly controlled, and the percentage poorly controlled, one decimal.
